stepTitle: Residual vector e has the same dimension as the parameter vector $$\hat{\theta}.$$
stepBody:
Sarah fits an OLS model to predict the number of students $$	ext{num\_students}$$ at MLK Student Union using the humidity level (humidity) and time of day (time) as predictors. Her fitted model is
$$\hat{s}=	heta_0+	heta_1 h+	heta_2 t$$
where $$\hat{s}$$ is predicted $$	ext{num\_students},$$ $$h$$ is humidity and $$t$$ is time.
After fitting the optimal model, Sarah examines the residual vector $$e=Y-\hat{Y}$$
Select all statements below that are true.
